tools.name: list_recent_shared_scenarios
tools.title: List recent shared scenarios
tools.description: List the most recently created public shared SmartFunnel scenarios (id, active lead type, created_at). Useful for browsing available shared funnels.

limit.description: Maximum number of scenarios to return (default 10, max 50).

tools.name: get_shared_scenario
tools.title: Get shared scenario
tools.description: Fetch a publicly shared SmartFunnel scenario by its share ID. Returns the full scenario JSON, active lead type, AI conclusion, and creation date.

share_id.description: The share ID (uuid) of the shared scenario, as found in the /share/:shareId URL.
